body.statement: For every \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), every \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathcal T,\mathcal C}\), and every off-target allocation \(\eta\), \(P\{\Theta(s)\subseteq\widehat\Theta_\alpha\mid(n_z)_z\}\ge1-\alpha\). The event follows from \(P\{D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\widehat s_z\|s_z)>\rho_z(\alpha)\}\le\alpha/m\) and therefore remains valid at endpoint kinks and simultaneously for every linear functional of \(\operatorname{law}(Y_{\mathcal T})\). Calibration and every optimization dimension are independent of \(|\mathcal C|\); direct response-type computation uses \((|\mathcal T|+1)^m2^{|\mathcal T|}\) columns and is exponential only in \(m\) and \(|\mathcal T|\).
body.justification: The guarantee protects the complete sharp set in finite samples without selecting an active endpoint formula.
body.gap: Song et al. project a full-alphabet KL region under full exclusion; this theorem first quotients the weaker target-only model and removes \(|\mathcal C|\) from calibration and computation.
body.consumer: Analysts with finely coded nonadherence or dosage deviations obtain honest whole-set uncertainty without merging scientific target levels.
